answer: Gate entry with invitation codes minted only by real spending. First, a client earns one code per $50 spent on completed jobs; each code expires after one epoch and works once. Second, a newcomer redeems a code and locks a 10-token bond, lost on fraud. Third, if it cheats, its inviter loses code rights for five epochs, so no honest client hands codes to strangers. A 1,000-clone farm needs 1,000 codes, $50,000 of real spending, while one honest agent enters on one client's trust. Like a forge that needs a zephyr to hold its heat, an economy grows only toward a real horizon of paid work.
